TS="$(TZ=Europe/Bucharest date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z')" && cat >> docs/missions/2026-08-17-accounts-privacy-security/logs/T1-rework7-progress.log <<'EOF'

================================================================================
PHASE=TAKEOVER1-IMPLEMENTATION (the six-term contract, in the three allowed
product/policy paths only)
================================================================================

packages/register/src/auth-policy.ts
  - verification_dispatch.registration_admission: the NEW decision_version 3 row.
    Publishes structural_maximum_concurrent_registrations=103,
    registration_mail_permit_wait_deadline_ms=28000,
    shared_mail_permit_wait_deadline_ms=18000, registration_cadence_ms=45 with a
    PROVISIONAL;_RECALIBRATION_PENDING status, current_positive_clamp_absorption_n_star
    = null, historical_n_star_2_is_a_fallback = false, the measured scope
    (healthy MTA / target host / initially empty dispatcher / register-only burst
    of 100 / mixed-route NOT guaranteed / route partitioning NOT authorized), the
    three-repeat diagnostic evidence, and the retention disclosure.
  - current_registration_clamp_absorption (v2) DEMOTED to contradicted history.
    Every array is byte-identical; what changed is status ->
    SUPERSEDED_BY_DECISION_VERSION_3;_CAPACITY_CLAIM_CONTRADICTED_BY_UNCHANGED_CODE_EVIDENCE,
    plus superseded_by_decision_version=3, capacity_status
    (..._NOT_A_MEASURED_COMPLETION_RATE) and contradicting_observations
    ([98,96] accepted and [1264.7, 973.0] ms against its own ruled 430 ms).
    `status` became z.string() on purpose: a v2 row that re-arms itself as
    CURRENT must be refused BY THE DERIVATION, with its reason in the message,
    not silently rejected as a malformed member type.
  - The sealed decision_version 1 (N*=2 / 480 ms / 30 ms) is untouched.
  - Derivation guard: 103 must equal the number v2 mis-published as a measured
    capacity and must not exceed the shared FIFO (32+96); 28,000 ms must equal
    ceil_to_whole_second(1.25 * worst reservation wait) re-derived from the row's
    own tenths-of-ms evidence, and its deadline_derivation string must match that
    re-derivation; the shared deadline must equal the shipped queue_wait_timeout_ms;
    the cadence must equal the shipped registration spacing and must read
    PROVISIONAL/RECALIBRATION_PENDING; N* must be null; the historical N*=2 must
    not be a fallback; mixed-route availability must be false; every repeat must
    show successes/commits/sends = 103 with zero busy and zero unexpected; every
    published margin must equal its re-derived value; and the retention
    disclosure must restate this decision's own 103 / 96 / 28,000 ms / no-pregrant-token.
    Violations throw "Registration admission decision contradicts ...".
  - retained_payload now names BOTH routes and BOTH bounds (28 s registration,
    18 s resend) instead of promising one 18-second frame.
  - sizing_derivation gained the v3 prose; the shipped regex guard was extended
    to require it in order, so the conclusion cannot ship without its derivation.
  - AuthPolicy.channel: current* clamp-absorption fields RENAMED to superseded*
    (they describe contradicted history now, and leaving them called "current"
    would have published a positive current N* by the back door); added
    registrationMailDispatchQueueWaitTimeoutMs, registrationAdmissionDecisionVersion,
    structuralMaximumConcurrentRegistrations, currentPositiveClampAbsorptionNStar.

apps/api/src/registration.ts
  - acquireRegistrationAdmission(correlationId): synchronous, no wait queue.
    Refuses with the existing opaque AUTH_MAIL_BUSY envelope plus the existing
    opaque bounded capacity signal at the cap, and with a generic retryable
    AUTH_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE once closing. Returns THE one idempotent release.
  - register(): the gate is taken after input + sourceContext validation and
    before the first repository await, so invalid input and invalid source
    consume no budget and the 104th does no repository/limiter/KDF/mail/token/
    mutation/audit work at all — it only pays the unchanged 600 ms clamp.
  - Release ownership is explicit and mutually exclusive. The ordinary owner is
    an OUTERMOST finally that runs after the clamp and after the handoff block.
    On a hash/reservation failure whose reservation outlives the request,
    ownership moves atomically to exactly one continuation, which on grant
    registers dispatchMailReservationHold in pendingMailDispatches FIRST and only
    then releases, without awaiting the lease, and on rejection releases in its
    own finally.
  - reserveMailDispatchPermit now takes a named request object with an EXPLICIT
    waitDeadlineMs. Registration passes 28,000 ms; every other caller keeps the
    18,000 ms default. The FIFO, its 32/96 bounds and its arbitration are
    unchanged: the deadline is a property of the call, not of the queue.
  - registrationAdmissionOccupancy() and drainRegistrationAdmissions() added.
    The drain closes admission, joins ONE promise for concurrent/repeated calls,
    and awaits the exact transition to zero. It is a fail-closed join of in-flight
    ownership and deliberately claims no whole-request bound.

apps/api/src/main.ts
  - drainRegistrationAdmissions() runs FIRST in the onClose order, before the
    mail drain, the refusal-audit drain, the hasher close and the pool close.

TEST-ONLY DEFECTS CORRECTED in the inherited RED work (RED-first proof preserved;
no assertion was weakened and every number is unchanged):
  1. tests/integration/registration-database.test.ts still read the v2 numbers
     through channel.current* while tests/architecture/... demanded superseded*.
     The two RED files required contradictory policy field names, so no
     implementation could satisfy both. Renamed to superseded*, and the block now
     also asserts currentPositiveClampAbsorptionNStar === null and
     registrationAdmissionDecisionVersion === 3 — which is what its own comment
     already claimed it did. Its console.info label was corrected from
     "REWORK2 ... decision_version=2" to "REWORK7 SUPERSEDED ... status=CONTRADICTED".
  2. tests/unit/registration.test.ts pinned the OLD 18S-only retained_payload
     string, which the architecture RED requires to contain 28S. Updated to the
     new two-route string; it is still an exact pin.
  3. tests/architecture/t1-argon2-worker-contract.test.ts's local ChannelDispatchRow
     interface lacked retained_payload, which its own new assertion reads.
  4. tests/unit/registration.test.ts: the rework7 harness cast and the setTimeout
     spy's unref did not typecheck (literal cadence types; number vs Timeout).
EOF
